scholarship_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students (PM-USP)
summary: Financial support for top 20th percentile Class 12 passed students pursuing regular graduate or postgraduate degree programs.
eligibility: Students above 80th percentile in Class 12 board exam, enrolled in regular UG/PG courses with annual family income up to ₹4.5 Lakh.
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum for graduation (first 3 years) and ₹20,000 per annum for postgraduate studies.
key_points: Must be above 80th percentile in relevant 12th board stream
Disbursed directly via DBT through National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Applicable for recognized colleges and universities in India

scholarship_name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Degree/Diploma)
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
summary: Empowers meritorious female students admitted to 1st year or 2nd year (lateral entry) AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma courses.
eligibility: Female students admitted to AICTE approved technical degree/diploma programs. Maximum 2 girls per family. Family income <= ₹8 Lakh.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards college fee payment, books, equipment, and laptop purchase.
key_points: Exclusively for female students in technical education
Up to 10,000 scholarships awarded annually across India
Applied via National Scholarship Portal (NSP)

scholarship_name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
summary: Financial support for specially-abled students with disability not less than 40% pursuing technical degree or diploma courses.
eligibility: Specially-abled students (disability >= 40%) admitted to AICTE approved institutions with family income <= ₹8 Lakh per annum.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of technical study.
key_points: Valid disability certificate required (min 40%)
Covers all eligible specially-abled students admitted to AICTE courses
Direct DBT transfer through NSP

scholarship_amount: Full tuition fee waiver + monthly maintenance allowance
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: Centrally sponsored scheme enabling Scheduled Caste students to pursue post-matriculation or post-secondary studies.
eligibility: SC students studying in post-matriculation courses in recognized institutions with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh.
benefits: Full reimbursement of non-refundable tuition fees and academic maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500/year.
key_points: Valid caste certificate and income certificate mandatory
Covers Class 11 up to PhD programs
Managed via state scholarship portals and NSP

summary: Empowers Scheduled Tribe students across India to complete higher education across degree, diploma, and doctoral levels.
eligibility: ST category students pursuing recognized post-matric courses whose parents' annual income does not exceed ₹2.5 Lakh.
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement, book grant, and monthly maintenance allowance.
key_points: All recognized professional and general courses covered
Applicable for both hostellers and day scholars
Apply via National Scholarship Portal

scholarship_amount: Admission, tuition fee waiver + maintenance allowance up to ₹10,000/yr
summary: Financial support for meritorious minority community students (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) for higher education.
eligibility: Students belonging to notified minority communities with >= 50% marks in previous exam and family income <= ₹2.0 Lakh.
benefits: Admission and tuition fees up to ₹7,000 p.a. and maintenance allowance up to ₹3,800 to ₹10,000 p.a.
key_points: 30% of scholarships earmarked for female students
Applicable from Class 11 up to Ph.D.
Direct DBT credit into student bank account

scholarship_name: Merit-Cum-Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses (Minorities)
summary: Assistance for minority students pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate professional and technical courses (Engineering, Medical, MBA, etc.).
eligibility: Minority community students admitted to professional/technical courses with >= 50% in qualifying exam and family income <= ₹2.5 Lakh.
benefits: Course fee up to ₹20,000 per annum and maintenance allowance of ₹1,000/month for hostellers (₹500 for day scholars).
key_points: Covers listed premier institutions (IITs, NITs, IIMs) with full fee reimbursement
Apply through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Renewable every year based on academic performance

scholarship_name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region (NER)
summary: Special scholarship by UGC to promote higher education among students having domicile of North Eastern states.
eligibility: Students with domicile of NER (Assam, Arunachal, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura) admitted to 1st year general/technical UG degree with income <= ₹4.5 Lakh.
benefits: ₹5,400 per month for general degree and ₹7,800 per month for technical/medical/professional courses.
key_points: 10,000 fresh scholarships awarded every year
Requires valid Domicile Certificate of NE State
Apply on National Scholarship Portal

scholarship_name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for CAPFs, AR and Assam Rifles
summary: Encourages higher technical and professional education for dependent wards and widows of Central Armed Police Forces and Assam Rifles personnel.
eligibility: Wards/widows of deceased/ex/serving CAPFs & AR personnel pursuing professional courses (Engineering, Medicine, Dental, Veterinary, BBA, BCA, MBA, MCA) with min 60% in 10+2/Diploma/Graduation.
benefits: ₹36,000 per annum for female students and ₹30,000 per annum for male students.
key_points: Applicable for technical and professional degree programs
Disbursed directly by Ministry of Home Affairs via NSP
Priority given to wards of martyrs and personnel disabled in action

provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
summary: Provides financial aid to orphans, wards of parents who died due to Covid-19, and wards of Armed Forces personnel martyred in action pursuing technical education.
eligibility: Orphan students, Covid-19 affected students, or wards of martyred Armed Forces personnel admitted to AICTE approved degree/diploma courses with family income <= ₹8 Lakh.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum towards tuition and incidental charges.
key_points: 2,000 scholarships available annually (1000 Degree + 1000 Diploma)
Requires relevant certificate (Death certificate / Martyr certificate)
Applied through National Scholarship Portal

scholarship_name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (MahaDBT)
provider: Directorate of Higher & Technical Education, Maharashtra
summary: Tuition and exam fee reimbursement scheme for economically backward students of Maharashtra pursuing professional and non-professional higher education.
eligibility: Domicile of Maharashtra, admitted through CAP rounds to approved courses with annual family income up to ₹8 Lakh.
benefits: 50% reimbursement of tuition and examination fees.
key_points: Must have Maharashtra Domicile and Cap round admission letter
Applied via MahaDBT portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in)
Valid for government, aided, and non-aided private colleges

provider: Higher Education Department, Government of Odisha
summary: State scholarship scheme for meritorious students of Odisha pursuing Junior, Senior, PG, and Technical/Professional courses.
eligibility: Permanent resident of Odisha with >= 60% in previous exam, enrolled in regular courses, and parental income <= ₹6.0 Lakh.
benefits: ₹5,000/yr for +2 / Junior; ₹10,000/yr for Technical / Professional / PG courses.
key_points: Over 23,000 scholarships disbursed across Odisha students annually
Apply via Odisha State Scholarship Portal
Disbursed through direct beneficiary transfer
